summary: Re-tested the two previously failing scenarios from iteration_1. Both fixes verified. (1) Cart persistence: after add-to-cart-p-001 + reload, cart-count-badge stayed '1', localStorage 'niceshoe_cart_v1' retained the item JSON (not '[]'), and the cart sheet still showed Sneaker Urban White with total 1.290.000 đ. (2) Newsletter invalid email: 'not-an-email' now triggers the sonner error toast 'Vui lòng nhập email hợp lệ' (form noValidate works). Subsequent valid email 'test@example.com' still shows success toast 'Đăng ký thành công'.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext.jsx now uses lazy useState initializer to hydrate synchronously from localStorage and removed the redundant hydrate effect — race condition resolved.
Newsletter.jsx form has noValidate, allowing JS regex validation + toast.error path to execute.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 scenarios from the niceshoe landing page now pass. Iteration 1's two failures (cart persistence on reload, newsletter invalid-email toast) are fully resolved and verified via Playwright. No further frontend bugs found in this targeted re-test.
rca of the issue: Previously: (a) CartContext had a hydrate-from-localStorage useEffect that ran AFTER the persist-to-localStorage useEffect on first mount, so the empty initial state was written before hydration. Fix: lazy useState initializer reads localStorage synchronously on first render. (b) Newsletter form used default <form> with <input type=email>, so the browser blocked submit on invalid input and the JS toast.error path was unreachable. Fix: added noValidate to the form. Both fixes confirmed working.
